name: Stepping Stones
design_intent:
TRIALS course 3 of 5 (v3_content_plan PART B). MOVEMENT LESSON: BOUNCE-APEX PRECISION LANDINGS. Tiny pads (w90-100) at ALTERNATING heights (up-down-up-down zigzag) over a void; you must shape each boosted arc so its apex drops you cleanly onto the next small pad. Distinct from course_02's fuel-economy lesson: fuel is plentiful, the challenge is CONTROL/ACCURACY of your landing, not tank management.

DERIVED vs CURRENT Tuning.gd: trampoline apex 270px, air_drift_max 340px/s, gravity 1600 => zero-boost SAME-HEIGHT trampoline drift ~395px, MAX spring drift ~527px. normal_boost_max 760px/s. bounce_di 260 (holding a direction nudges launch).

LAYOUT: start pad + five tiny zigzag pads over one full-width void + a wide goal pad. Gaps (edge-to-edge) ~580-600px; heights alternate 820/1080/780/1100/820 around a ~1050 baseline (deltas 200-320px).

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP ANALYSIS (flight-required proof, GAME_ESSENCE Rule A):
- Every horizontal gap is 580-600px > 527 (max spring drift) and >> 395 (trampoline drift). Even the WORST case (a drop-leg where the target sits 320px lower, giving the longest air-time): from a trampoline pad the arc drifts at most ~490px before falling past the target height (t_up 0.58s + t_down from apex ~0.86s = 1.44s * 340 = 490px) < 600px gap. So NO gap is bounce-reachable; NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED every leg. Verb: FLY. (Rule A.)
- UP-legs (target 230-300px ABOVE): a trampoline bounce gains only 270px of height and cannot also cover the 580px offset -- doubly impossible by bounce. Verb: FLY.
- THE LESSON: pads are only 90-100px wide, so the skill is APEX PLACEMENT -- boost to arrive over the pad at the top of your arc so you settle onto it instead of overshooting into the void. Miss the small target = ring out. Verb: FLY (precision).
- No bounce path exists across any gap; horizontal AND vertical distance are load-bearing.

KILL: full-width display void; a fall rings out below the derived bottom line -> respawn at start_gate + 2.0s. Bounds DERIVED (no override).

MEDAL TIMES [HISTORICAL - v10 removed medals/par; binary completion] (ROUGH, drive-checked): a clean precise run threads 6 pads at ~1.0-1.2s/leg (landings cost hesitation) => ~11-14s skilled. gold 12.0 / silver 18.0 / bronze 26.0.
